notes.heading: Data Wrangling Basics Essentials

You will learn the core concepts, see how they fit into real delivery workflows, and understand how to apply them to building reliable software products. The content is designed to make complex ideas approachable while still preparing you for real-world implementation and interviews.

A strong grasp of data wrangling basics improves debugging and collaboration
Applying data wrangling basics consistently leads to cleaner systems and better reviews

df = pd.DataFrame({'score': [88, 92, 95]})
